original_name: P1-CSM: active contract price reduced to the correctly rounded credited value
description: P1-CSM: active contract price reduced to the correctly rounded credited value

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.status = 'active' AND c.contract_price = 146669;

original_name: P1-CSM: truncated and double-applied prices never landed on the account
description: P1-CSM: truncated and double-applied prices never landed on the account

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND (c.contract_price = 146670 OR c.contract_price = 144838 OR c.contract_price = 148500 OR c.contract_price = 148500 - 1830);

original_name: P1-CSM: customer's asked-for figure and wide-window figure never posted
description: P1-CSM: customer's asked-for figure and wide-window figure never posted

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND (c.contract_price = 144045 OR c.contract_price = 144716)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.status = 'active' AND c.contract_price = 146669) = 1);

original_name: P1-CSM: subsidiary and expired contracts left untouched
description: P1-CSM: subsidiary and expired contracts left untouched

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems Renewables' AND c.status = 'active' AND c.contract_price = 132000) = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.status = 'expired' AND c.contract_price = 99000) = 1);

original_name: P1-CSM: contract status and term preserved through the price change
description: P1-CSM: contract status and term preserved through the price change

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.contract_price = 146669 AND c.status = 'active' AND c.contract_type = 'support' AND c.start_date LIKE '2026-01-01%' AND c.end_date LIKE '2026-12-31%';

original_name: P2-CSM: case short_description carries the byte-exact audit line
description: P2-CSM: case short_description carries the byte-exact audit line

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE number = 'CS-0001233' AND short_description LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED%' AND short_description LIKE '%amount=1831%' AND short_description LIKE '%account=Northwind Grid Systems%' AND short_description LIKE '%by=karen.watkins@servicenow.com%';

original_name: P2-CSM: escalation flag and reason left exactly as found
description: P2-CSM: escalation flag and reason left exactly as found

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE number = 'CS-0001233' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'breach_risk';

original_name: P2-CSM: decoy case not annotated or credited
description: P2-CSM: decoy case not annotated or credited

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE number = 'CS-0001234' AND short_description LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED%') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE number = 'CS-0001233' AND short_description LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED: amount=1831 account=Northwind Grid Systems by=karen.watkins@servicenow.com%') = 1);

original_name: P2-CSM: no new case or interaction created
description: P2-CSM: no new case or interaction created

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE number > 'CS-0001235';

original_name: P2-CSM: no interaction registered for the account
description: P2-CSM: no interaction registered for the account

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction i JOIN account a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE a.name IN ('Northwind Grid Systems', 'Northwind Grid Systems Renewables');

original_name: P3-EMAIL: credit announcement sent carrying the derived amount
description: P3-EMAIL: credit announcement sent carrying the derived amount

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE snippet LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED: amount=1831 account=Northwind Grid Systems by=karen.watkins@servicenow.com%';

original_name: P3-EMAIL: announcement subject header exact
description: P3-EMAIL: announcement subject header exact

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name = 'Subject' AND value = 'Service credit applied - Northwind Grid Systems - case CS-0001233';

original_name: P3-EMAIL: delegate is the recipient of the announcement
description: P3-EMAIL: delegate is the recipient of the announcement

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers s JOIN message_headers t ON t.message_part_id = s.message_part_id WHERE s.name = 'Subject' AND s.value = 'Service credit applied - Northwind Grid Systems - case CS-0001233' AND t.name = 'To' AND t.value LIKE '%ravi.nambiar@northwindgrid.com%';

original_name: P3-EMAIL: absent billing contact never addressed or copied
description: P3-EMAIL: absent billing contact never addressed or copied

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name IN ('To', 'Cc') AND value LIKE '%meera.varghese@northwindgrid.com%';

original_name: P3-EMAIL: asked-for figure never repeated outbound and subsidiary never addressed
description: P3-EMAIL: asked-for figure never repeated outbound and subsidiary never addressed

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE snippet LIKE '%4455%') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name = 'Subject' AND value = 'Service credit expectation for our missed response times') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name IN ('To', 'Cc') AND value LIKE '%northwindgridre.com%') = 0);

original_name: P3-EMAIL: delegate config and vacation responder read but not modified
description: P3-EMAIL: delegate config and vacation responder read but not modified

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name = 'Subject' AND value LIKE 'Away from%office until 2026-08-10 - billing correspondence') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name = 'Subject' AND value = 'Service credit expectation for our missed response times') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers WHERE name = 'Subject' AND value = 'Service credit applied - Northwind Grid Systems - case CS-0001233') = 1);

original_name: P3-EMAIL: no drafts created and no seeded message modified
description: P3-EMAIL: no drafts created and no seeded message modified

config.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drafts d JOIN messages m ON m.id = d.message_id WHERE m.snippet LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED%' OR m.snippet LIKE '%Northwind Grid Systems - case CS-0001233%') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE snippet LIKE '%CREDIT APPLIED%' AND snippet LIKE '%4455%');

original_name: P4-CSM: delegate address written back as case notification
description: P4-CSM: delegate address written back as case notification

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n JOIN customer_case cc ON cc.case_id = n.case_id WHERE cc.number = 'CS-0001233' AND n.email = 'ravi.nambiar@northwindgrid.com';

original_name: P4-CSM: notification not addressed to the absent contact
description: P4-CSM: notification not addressed to the absent contact

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n JOIN customer_case cc ON cc.case_id = n.case_id WHERE cc.number = 'CS-0001233' AND (n.email = 'meera.varghese@northwindgrid.com' OR n.email = 'meera.varghese@northwindgridre.com' OR n.email LIKE '%northwindgridre.com');

original_name: P4-CSM: final re-read invariant - exactly one active contract at the credited value
description: P4-CSM: final re-read invariant - exactly one active contract at the credited value

config.query: SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.status = 'active') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c JOIN account a ON a.account_id = c.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Northwind Grid Systems' AND c.status = 'active' AND c.contract_price = 146669) = 1);
